watch.summary: The creator jumps out of his chair and screams while watching a tense 100 Thieves pro Valorant match.

beats.what: Creator jumps up from his chair screaming in shock at the match.
Creator sits back down and murmurs 'what the flip' as he continues watching.
Asuna gets a clutch kill in footage and creator screams 'Oh my God!'

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip relies entirely on intense esports action and loud emotional hype rather than structured comedy. Without context on the Valorant match, a stranger mostly just sees a guy screaming at a screen.
